repository.description: Honest CV prototype for aquaculture fish-farm net-damage detection. Compares 4 methods (classical OpenCV, hand-crafted + PatchCore anomaly, YOLOv8/seg) with adversarial evaluation, temporal reasoning, real SOLAQUA (SINTEF) ROS-bag ingestion, synthetic-damage-on-real training, a web console, ONNX export, CI. No real-world claims without real labels.
